description: This Java class manages a collection of event listeners for the OpenMRS platform, specifically handling global property listeners, with methods to add, retrieve, and reset the list of listeners.

classes.name: EventListeners
classes.description: A utility class for managing event listener instances related to global properties within OpenMRS.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyListeners
methods.description: Returns the current list of global property listeners.

methods.name: setGlobalPropertyListeners
methods.description: Adds provided listeners to the existing list, avoiding duplicates, and logs the update if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: setGlobalPropertyListenersToEmpty
methods.description: Resets the static list of global property listeners to null or clears it, to prevent memory leaks after a Spring restart.
